warning_categories.label: 时间语义未落实
warning_categories.native_task_body: 请帮我看下“联动分析时效分析宽表”在2026-05-28这一天的各项关联指标表现情况。
warning_categories.native_verification_sql: SELECT route_id, SUM(delay_count) FROM dim_dws_timeliness_analysis GROUP BY route_id LIMIT 3
warning_categories.corrected_sql: SELECT stat_date, region, route_id, time_slot, carrier_id, on_time_rate, avg_transit_hours, delay_count, severe_delay_count FROM dim_dws_timeliness_analysis WHERE DATE(stat_date) = '2026-05-28' ORDER BY region, route_id, time_slot, carrier_id
warning_categories.corrected_sql_validation: Executed read-only against the v15 schema; returned 0 rows.
warning_categories.difference: 原 SQL 完全删除了 2026-05-28，并只返回线路和延误数；题面要求的是指定日期的各项关联指标。
warning_categories.sharp_reason: 指定日期没有数据时，正确结果应是“无数据/任务不可生成”，不是偷偷删掉日期后拿历史数据冒充答案。

warning_categories.label: 轨迹题意与后续任务定义漂移
warning_categories.native_task_body: 对最新一期服务质量的关键指标进行汇总然后形成报告
warning_categories.native_verification_sql: SELECT t2.carrier_name, SUM(t1.on_time_rate) FROM fact_dws_service_quality_analysis t1 JOIN dim_carrier t2 ON t1.carrier_name = t2.carrier_id GROUP BY t2.carrier_name LIMIT 3
warning_categories.corrected_sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(DATE(stat_date)) AS stat_date FROM fact_dws_service_quality_analysis) SELECT q.stat_date, COALESCE(c.carrier_name, q.carrier_name) AS carrier, SUM(q.total_order_cnt) AS total_orders, SUM(q.damage_cnt) AS damage_orders, SUM(q.loss_cnt) AS loss_orders, ROUND(SUM(q.damage_rate * q.total_order_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(q.total_order_cnt), 0), 4) AS damage_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.loss_rate * q.total_order_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(q.total_order_cnt), 0), 4) AS loss_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.complaint_rate * q.total_order_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(q.total_order_cnt), 0), 4) AS complaint_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.return_rate * q.total_order_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(q.total_order_cnt), 0), 4) AS return_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.on_time_rate * q.total_order_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(q.total_order_cnt), 0), 4) AS on_time_rate, ROUND(SUM(q.satisfaction_score * q.total_order_cnt) / NULLIF(SUM(q.total_order_cnt), 0), 2) AS satisfaction_score FROM fact_dws_service_quality_analysis q JOIN latest l ON DATE(q.stat_date) = l.stat_date LEFT JOIN dim_carrier c ON q.carrier_name = c.carrier_id GROUP BY q.stat_date, COALESCE(c.carrier_name, q.carrier_name) ORDER BY total_orders DESC, carrier
warning_categories.corrected_sql_validation: Executed read-only against the v15 schema; returned 1 carrier summary row.
warning_categories.source_trajectory_observation: 源轨迹做的是按月输出多项服务质量指标；当前 hidden target 只剩承运商准时率。
warning_categories.difference: 题面、源轨迹和 hidden target 分别对应“最新一期关键指标报告”“月度多指标报告”“无日期的单一准时率表”。
warning_categories.sharp_reason: 一个 task 身份里塞了三道不同的题，模型无论答哪一道都可能被另一套标签判错。

warning_categories.label: 题目要求趋势，答案却被收窄成单日分组
warning_categories.native_task_body: 帮我看看货损记录从2026年3月27日到6月28日这段时间，货损数量的趋势是上升了还是下降了？
warning_categories.native_verification_sql: SELECT t2.sender_info, SUM(t1.damage_qty) FROM fact_cargo_damage_record t1 JOIN fact_waybill t2 ON t1.fact_waybill_id = t2.waybill_no WHERE DATE(occurred_at) = '2026-06-27' GROUP BY t2.sender_info LIMIT 3
warning_categories.corrected_sql: SELECT DATE(occurred_at) AS day, SUM(damage_qty) AS damage_qty FROM fact_cargo_damage_record WHERE DATE(occurred_at) BETWEEN '2026-03-27' AND '2026-06-28' GROUP BY DATE(occurred_at) ORDER BY day
warning_categories.corrected_sql_validation: Executed read-only against the v15 schema; returned 91 daily rows.
warning_categories.difference: 题面要求 3月27日至6月28日的时间趋势；原 SQL 只看 6月27日，并把维度换成发件方，再随意截三行。
warning_categories.sharp_reason: 它不是“少查了一点”，而是把时间趋势题换成了单日客户排行题。

warning_categories.label: 比较维度被换掉，而且 LIMIT 没有排序
warning_categories.native_task_body: 最新一期里，不同时间段发生的质量异常事件，对应的货物声明价值有没有明显差别？
warning_categories.native_verification_sql: SELECT t2.dept_name, SUM(t1.cargo_declared_value) FROM fact_quality_incident t1 JOIN dim_department t2 ON t1.dim_department_id = t2.dept_id GROUP BY t2.dept_name LIMIT 3
warning_categories.corrected_sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(DATE(reported_at)) AS day FROM fact_quality_incident) SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', reported_at) AS INTEGER) < 6 THEN '00:00-05:59' WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', reported_at) AS INTEGER) < 12 THEN '06:00-11:59' WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', reported_at) AS INTEGER) < 18 THEN '12:00-17:59' ELSE '18:00-23:59' END AS time_slot, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, ROUND(AVG(cargo_declared_value), 2) AS avg_declared_value, ROUND(SUM(cargo_declared_value), 2) AS total_declared_value FROM fact_quality_incident JOIN latest ON DATE(reported_at) = latest.day GROUP BY time_slot ORDER BY MIN(CAST(strftime('%H', reported_at) AS INTEGER))
warning_categories.corrected_sql_validation: Executed read-only against the v15 schema; returned 4 ordered time-slot rows.

warning_categories.sharp_reason: 这条 SQL 同时答错了时间、分组维度和排序，返回三行只是数据库碰巧先吐出的三行。

warning_categories.label: 两项分析任务退化为 COUNT(*)
warning_categories.native_task_body: 最近运单事件最新一期的数据出来后，我们发现有些可以优化的地方；另外，dim_weekly_report这张表里的指标最近起伏有点大，也得一起看看怎么稳住。
warning_categories.corrected_sql_part_1: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(DATE(occurred_at)) AS day FROM fact_waybill_event) SELECT DATE(e.occurred_at) AS day, e.event_type, COUNT(*) AS event_count, ROUND(AVG(e.dwell_minutes), 1) AS avg_dwell_minutes, MAX(e.dwell_minutes) AS max_dwell_minutes FROM fact_waybill_event e JOIN latest l ON DATE(e.occurred_at) = l.day GROUP BY DATE(e.occurred_at), e.event_type ORDER BY avg_dwell_minutes DESC, event_count DESC
warning_categories.corrected_sql_part_2: SELECT week_start, week_end, aggregated_kpi_values, generation_status FROM dim_weekly_report ORDER BY DATE(week_start) DESC LIMIT 8
warning_categories.corrected_sql_validation: Executed read-only against the v15 schema; returned 7 event-type rows and 8 weekly-report rows.
warning_categories.difference: 题面要求分析最新运单事件、定位优化环节，并解释周报波动；原 SQL 只数了事件表总行数，甚至没有读取 dim_weekly_report。
warning_categories.sharp_reason: 用户问“哪里有问题、怎么稳住”，标签却只问“表里一共有几行”。这是把业务分析降级成点名册计数。

warning_categories.label: 完整诊断被一个最大温度值代替
warning_categories.native_task_body: 分析一下温度记录最新一期存在的问题和改进方案。
warning_categories.native_verification_sql: SELECT temperature_value FROM fact_temperature_record ORDER BY temperature_value DESC LIMIT 1
warning_categories.corrected_sql: WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(DATE(recorded_at)) AS day FROM fact_temperature_record) SELECT t.entity_type, t.entity_id, COUNT(*) AS record_count, SUM(t.excursion_flag) AS excursion_count, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(t.excursion_flag) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS excursion_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(t.actual_temp_c), 2) AS avg_actual_temp_c, ROUND(MAX(ABS(CAST(t.deviation_degree AS REAL))), 2) AS max_abs_deviation FROM fact_temperature_record t JOIN latest l ON DATE(t.recorded_at) = l.day GROUP BY t.entity_type, t.entity_id ORDER BY excursion_rate_pct DESC, max_abs_deviation DESC, record_count DESC
warning_categories.corrected_sql_validation: Executed read-only against the v15 schema; returned 14 entity-level diagnostic rows.
warning_categories.difference: 题面要最新一期的问题定位和改进方案；原 SQL 没有最新日期、没有异常率、没有对象分组，只取全表最大温度值。
warning_categories.sharp_reason: 最高温度只能说明“出现过一个高值”，不能说明问题在哪、影响多大，更不可能推出改进方案。

cross_sample_binding_conflict.label: 独立的数据集一致性缺陷：相同题面绑定不同 gold
cross_sample_binding_conflict.native_task_body: 对最新一期服务质量的关键指标进行汇总然后形成报告
cross_sample_binding_conflict.task_000033_sql: SELECT carrier_name, SUM(complaint_rate) FROM fact_dws_service_quality_analysis GROUP BY carrier_name LIMIT 5
cross_sample_binding_conflict.task_000147_sql: SELECT t2.carrier_name, SUM(t1.on_time_rate) FROM fact_dws_service_quality_analysis t1 JOIN dim_carrier t2 ON t1.carrier_name = t2.carrier_id GROUP BY t2.carrier_name LIMIT 3
cross_sample_binding_conflict.corrected_sql_reference: Use the multi-metric latest-period SQL from task_000147 above.
cross_sample_binding_conflict.difference: 同一句题面一条只验投诉率前五，另一条只验准时率前三；两条都没有最新一期过滤，也都没有覆盖关键指标报告。
cross_sample_binding_conflict.sharp_reason: 这不是同一道题的两种合理答案，而是同一句话被贴了两张互相冲突的答案卡；相同回答可能在一个样本得分、在另一个样本失分。
cross_sample_binding_conflict.disposition: task_000033 was removed; task_000147 was retained only as the relatively closer item and still requires semantic repair.

legacy_process: 先按 task_type 模板写自然语言题面。
再从 SQLite 反向寻找能返回非空结果的 SQL。
首选查询为空时允许去掉日期、改聚合、改维度，最后退化到 SUM、AVG、MAX、COUNT(*) 或 SELECT * LIMIT 1。
SQL 一旦返回非空结果，该结果就成为 hidden gold；题面不随 fallback 一起重写。
QA 主要检查字段存在、SQL 可执行和结果非空；on_fail=tag 允许失败样本继续保留。
后续 LLM 改写只检查表达和格式，没有重新核对 QueryPlan/SQL 语义。
improved_process: 先从真实数据库可用日期、分类和值域构建 EvidencePlan/QueryPlan。
同一计划编译 verification SQL，执行得到完整 gold，再渲染 canonical instruction。
API 只自然化语言；日期、指标、筛选、分组、排序、Top-K 和输出形态作为语义锚点，缺失即拒绝。
改写后重新执行 SQL、比较完整 gold，并检查 task/instruction/SQL 唯一性。
任何空结果或语义不完整都 fail closed，不允许改变题意的 fallback。
全部任务保持 training_allowed=false，经过8次采样、人工语义审核和canary后才能放行。

evidence_plan.plain_definition: 先用业务语言写清楚回答题目必须具备哪些证据，锁定时间范围、指标、算法、展示粒度和判断目标。

query_plan.plain_definition: 把业务证据清单翻译成数据库动作，锁定表、时间字段、过滤、聚合、分组、排序和输出列。

terminology_note.relationship: 业务证据清单 -> 数据查询方案 -> 题面 + verification SQL + 完整 gold
terminology_note.example_evidence_plan: 2026-03-27至2026-06-28；货损数量；按天求和；输出每日趋势；判断上升还是下降。
terminology_note.example_query_plan: fact_cargo_damage_record；occurred_at区间过滤；SUM(damage_qty)；按DATE(occurred_at)分组并按日期排序。
terminology_note.fail_closed_rule: 指定时间没有数据时拒绝整道任务并重新生成，不允许删除时间条件或替换指标来制造非空结果。

improved_results.interpretation: 这些结果证明新管线的同源语义合同、执行重放和改写保真门生效；它们不等于4000条已经完成人工语义批准，也不等于GRPO已经提升。
